# Echo Memory

> A local-first macOS conversation memory library that turns imported audio into timestamped transcripts, source-backed decisions and action items, project knowledge, local search, and read-only MCP context for AI tools.

- Canonical repository: https://github.com/questionjie-max/echo-memory
- License: Apache-2.0
- Platform: macOS
- Current stage: Alpha, source build only
- Inputs: MP3, M4A, WAV
- Processing: local Whisper / whisper.cpp and optional local Ollama
- Privacy: audio and transcripts remain local in the current Alpha; no silent cloud fallback
- MCP: disabled by default, local stdio, read-only, no public listener or write operations
